The evaluator consequently requested sibling prediction files that are not present in a single-video raw output directory; BT-003 and SN-001 exposed this as a missing BT-001.txt error before any metric was accepted.
scientific_effect: None. All 36 raw manifests, predictions and actual-output traces were already complete; the failed finalizer produced no accepted metrics and did not modify raw inference outputs.

repair.rerun: All six per-video finalizers were rerun from clean finalizer artifacts and completed successfully; the aggregate then verified all 36 runs.

note: This is a protocol-scoping and finalization repair boundary. It does not establish a method contribution, selective-combination value, or positive metric effect.
